ACTIVE_OLD_LANE.description: Previous mutator still owns the named scope.

STOPPED.description: Previous lane explicitly stopped before transfer.

STALLED_NAMED.description: A coordination decision names why the lane is treated as stalled; elapsed time alone is insufficient.

NARROWED.description: Previous lane surrendered the transferred scope while possibly retaining a disjoint scope.

HANDBACK.description: Previous lane delivered and returned control.

PARTIAL_FAILURE.description: Previous mutation failed or partially completed; recovery must preserve history.

REACQUIRE_HEAD.description: Read current head and compare it with the previous lane's last claimed head.

CLAIM_HISTORICAL.description: Required when the current head differs from the previous last claimed head.

TRANSFER_SCOPE.description: Name new owner, inherited no-touch constraints, consequence class and transferred write scope.

AUTHORIZED.description: Request-specific legible authorization for consequential work or explicit scope/no-touch widening.

START_NEW_LANE.description: New mutator starts from the exact reacquired head; previous lane is not concurrently mutating transferred scope.

FORWARD_RECOVERY.description: Repair a partial failure using forward history-preserving mutation.

WORK.description: Bounded mutation inside transferred scope and inherited gates.

HAND_BACK.description: Return an observable receipt. Receipt is not agreement, approval or review.
